blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur—The Batac City Police Station (CBPS) in Ilocos Norte called on the public to stop spreading unverified information and exposing the identities of minors involved in an alleged school-related security incident. In an official statement Tuesday, the police said the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) is leading the investigation, with the Philippine National Police, the local government, the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO), and other agencies providing support.
